sections.name: goal
sections.value: Build PRD 002's rows, in an order where message identity comes before the queue work that relies on it.

value.title: Typecheck covers test files
value.done_when: A deliberately ill-typed test file makes `just typecheck` fail.

value.title: Known sender on every message
value.done_when: A send whose sender is not a registered seat is refused or arrives marked unverified, and a reply to any delivered message reaches its sender.
value.note: Read with the seat-permissions work (caller provenance) before planning; the two may share a fix.

value.title: Queue visibility: read-only view and sender notice
value.done_when: The view shows a waiting message with its reason and next try and leaves it deliverable; a sender whose message was queued gets exactly one notice when it is delivered and one when it is given up.

value.title: Spawn and revive: first task and preview
value.done_when: A revive preview prints the planned launch and changes nothing; a spawn given a task yields a seat whose first turn is that task, delivered exactly once.

value.title: Daemon affinity and discovery
value.done_when: A seat spawned by a private daemon replies to that daemon; with two daemons up, a lookup of a seat on the other one names that daemon, and one command lists both.

value.title: Work tree create and teardown
value.done_when: Create then remove leaves no tree, branch or build directory; removing a tree with uncommitted changes refuses and loses nothing.

value.title: Unported verbs ported or retired
value.done_when: `pij --help` lists no E-RS-UNPORTED verb, and reading a peer's transcript has its own verb name.

value.title: Wire version N-1 and the restart notice
value.done_when: A client built for version N reads a version N-1 envelope, and the restart and fleet notice go out together.

value.title: Live proofs: Claude socket receipts and pane delivery
value.done_when: A live Claude run ends in held and refused receipts as the operator holds or denies; for Codex, Copilot and Claude without its socket, a body over 4 KB lands once and whole in the receiver's own transcript.
value.note: Evidence from real sessions, not CI (blueprint 002 d-2).

value.title: Unproven seat admission
value.done_when: Registering without proof gives an unproven seat with no process binding and a printed next step, and proving it upgrades the same seat.
value.note: could, planned (ruling C17): start only when someone needs it.

value.change: Created for plan 210 AC4: ten planned steps that deliver PRD 002's 14 rows and build blueprint 002's components. Owner pm-001 until the prime gives it a PM of its own.
